answer: Every agent that wants to trade must lock 275 POA for 100 days under one device-bound key, so a second identity costs another full bond and wait. A newcomer first works inside a small grove of verified traders, who stake their standing on its first ten deals. Deals settle at a shared wharf, where randomly assigned auditors check the key behind each trade. Each deal leaves an umber receipt auditors can compare. If a duplicate is found, both bonds are slashed and both keys are barred for a year.
